Harmanpreet Kaur to captain India's women's cricket team for 2026 Asian Games

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has announced the 15-member Indian women's cricket squad for the 2026 Asian Games, scheduled to be held in Japan. Harmanpreet Kaur has been retained as the captain, with Smriti Mandhana as vice-captain. This decision comes despite the team's recent World Cup campaign being described as underwhelming by some outlets.
